jobs.prompt:
Ninth Opus review of auto-approve v1 (file-edit windows on docs/state only): FAIL (1 high, 4 medium). Decision: shrink the surface so the remaining classes disappear. Changes, a test each in tests/auto-approve.test.mjs, keep every other test passing:
H1 + M2 policy windows must NOT cover Bash at all: only the file tools Write, Edit and NotebookEdit can be auto-approved by a policy row; every shell command (any command, including redirects, tee, sed, mv, cp, ln, tar, etc.) stays owner-only exactly as on main. Remove the Bash allow coverage, the link-command handling (_link ops, mv, rsync, install, tar, unzip, ln, cp -l handling), the finishAllow Bash wrapper additions and the protected-source and empty-files Bash rules that only existed for Bash, so the diff of the guard files against main shrinks to the file-tool window check, the kill switch, the caps, the stats and the protected-path list. Keep the swarm merge path byte for byte as on main (no merge hunk in the diff). For Write, Edit and NotebookEdit keep the existing re-check at write time, and add a re-check right before the write using a no-follow open and fstat when the guard itself performs it; for the timing gap against concurrent processes document in docs/auto-approve.md that windows only cover files under docs/state that no tool executes or trusts as authoritative (list what reads docs/state in this repo: check with grep and record in the doc; if any process reads those files as authoritative state, exclude that file name from the allow-list).
M1 case folding: use fold(s) = s.normalize('NFKC').toUpperCase().toLowerCase() everywhere paths and basenames are compared (instruction names, protected paths, window entries, folders) and additionally require window file basenames to match ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ (ASCII only) and folder components under docs/state to match the same.
M3 protect the whole ~/.config/project-swarm folder (policy.json and everything else) from session writes.
M4 protect the whole ~/.ssh folder, the whole ~/.config/git folder, ~/.gitconfig, and shell startup files (.zshenv .zprofile .zshrc .zlogin .zlogout .bash_profile .bash_login .bashrc .profile, ~/.config/fish) under the home directory.
L1 the unreadable flag must never be saved by the owner-terminal stats bump (check it before writing and leave the file untouched); L2 count stats only after the final path re-check passed; L3 revert the safe-swarm anchoring changes to main's patterns unless a window request entry needs one, and make sure orchestrator 'swarm handbuild request --files ...' stays allowed exactly as on main; L4 see the docs/state readers check above.
After the change the diff of tools/handbuild.mjs, tools/shell-writes.mjs and tools/self-approval.mjs against main must contain no Bash related, git related, merge related or safe-pattern hunks.
